reviews.text: My dogs love this place so much that everyday on a dog walk we walk past it. They want to go in and say hi to the owners and workers

Im in the process of moving up here and my boyfriend scheduled an appointment for my not so nervous pup. They were very nice when I dropped Bruce off. Hes part husky so its shedding season and needed to get a deshed. All I can say is im so happy with how he came back looking! His long fur was trimmed and the extra fur is gone. He also smelled nice and was so soft! I will definitely be bringing him back along with my other pup!
wonderful, kind groomers. Owner is very thoughtful

I’ve been bringing my Frenchie, Tito, to The Dog Room for over two years now, and they are essentially family at this point. As a small business, they go above and beyond—they actually call me to schedule his appointments because they know I’m forgetful, which is a lifesaver.

The best part? It’s a cage-free environment. For a breed like a Frenchie, less stress is everything. Evan is incredible and always adapts to Tito’s changing skin needs throughout the seasons, so I never have to worry about irritation. They have his "wash day" routine down like clockwork: bath, and hype him up for his pup cup, then off to see Grandma. It’s half the price of the big-box brands but with twice the compassion. If you want a place that actually knows your dog's name and needs, this is it.
Precise work, my pups always leave looking very cute ☺️ the dog room always takes good care of my pups!

He did a beautiful job on my Bichon, with a turnaround time of under an hour. She was long overdue for a touch-up and had turned gray from rolling in the mud, but I picked her up looking impeccably clean and perfectly groomed. The service felt both high-quality and thoughtfully priced. I’ll absolutely be returning. Thank you.

It was our 1st time at the dog room with my puppy.  I am very happy with the care and effort taken with my little guy.  Thank you for all the great work you do. This place was recommended to me and now I know why. Great care and service.  We will definitely be going back.
Always a friendly and welcoming environment! Our dog Nala has anxiety but is calm and looking great when it's pick up time!

Truly love this place the staff are so friendly and my dogs have a forever home. Always so caring, attentive, and do a great job with watching my dog (s) when I leave for out of town. Truly am grateful for the dog room. My dogs made new friends.Thank you Evan, and Patrick truly incredible people!
Always super friendly & super quick.
Gentle care for my dog Molly and beautifully groomed.

Was told of this place and at last min was able to get her a appointment for my jasmine I recommend all to take there animaos here great price and service thanks for al lowing me and jasmine to be a part of this family 🙏🏻🫶💋😏😇🥰😘❤️💕 …

Love this place! They do not cage the dogs & only groom a few at a time. Their service is so quick (usually done in an hour or so) & their hours are pretty flexible. They always try their best to accommodate you (& your dog) when they can. Thank you to The Dog Room for making my boy look extra handsome!

I’ve been taking my Lhasa Poo here for about 6 years now. Even after I moved 45 minutes away I still make the drive to take my baby to get groomed by Yuri ( but really everyone is great there). They are very kind and I love how there’s no cages. The usual wait is a little over an hour ( my dog is 19lbs) and the prices are very reasonable. I will only trust The Dog Room to care and groom my baby. Thank you for your great service! I highly recommend.
They were so sweet and got us in last minute to help our senior dog. They were very gentle and helped ease our old girls mind. Thank you!
I love everything they do. They take care of my dog.

They fitted me in at the last minute. My dog has a big tumor and is very old. They were extremely gentle with her and she looks amazing!!! Our first time here and we will be back!  Reasonable prices!!! Amazing!  Highly recommend!!
This place is the best! The customer service and attention to my pet is over the top.
Great little place. Very friendly and very good services. Remember cash for tips, though! They deserve it.

I can’t say enough good things about the owner and staff.

The grooming is always spot on. The owner is fantastic along with her son

Prices are reasonable

Been a long time client and will continue to take my fur babies here as long as they’re here

Keep up the great work
I have a Yorkshire Terrier and his groomer Patrick from The Dog Room does an excellent job.
She is the best and most lovely person

From the first day I took my dog ​​Ender there, they made her look beautiful and she smelled wonderful. I really like how they treat her, and I have no complaints about the price; it's worth it to see how beautiful my girl looks.
Always a pleasure.  No cages only 2 or 3 Dogs at one time. Usually done within 2 hours or less  Very nice staff. Best advertisement. My Dog never refuses to go in.

People taking their dogs to this place, I recommend you check them thoroughly from head to tail.
My dog ​​came out with an injured paw between his pads. The owner told me they aren't responsible once the dogs leave. Check your pets very well before leaving that place.
They are irresponsible and unprofessional. In my dog's seven years of life, this has never happened to him, and the woman is shirking her responsibility.
Professional, courteous, friendly personnel. Highly recommend this place to all the furbabies Mama's. Reasonably priced, especially with high rocket costs all over. Won't disappoint!
